items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Mealy Bones to play there too.

ctx.x: So I know, that place there and Paul Bones to play there. Uh huh. That's right. Mealy Bones to play there too. Uh huh. Well alright yeah, Joe, Joe, Joe, Joe played with Paul one night down there. Joe James. Yeah Joe said he never won't play back down there but you know what I mean, you say it was four o'clock in the morning getting back home, daylight. Yeah?
